subject: Request for margin relief & custom packaging for Synthex Labs - VP/CFO signoff needed
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T08:12:00Z
Subject: Request for margin relief & custom packaging for Synthex Labs - background attached

Team,

Quick background: Synthex Labs (Series B, clinical AI for imaging) verbally committed to a multi-year purchase but has pushed for a bespoke packaging that combines Dedicated capacity + Hosted fallback. They are asking for a blended effective rate that is ~32% below standard enterprise list given the initial year ramps and a 24-month commitment. Key commercials below: 

- Estimated ARR (year 1 runrate after ramp): $1.2M
- Commit: 24 months with 30% upfront prepay (customer preference)
- Ask: 32% structural discount + waived onboarding professional services fee (~$45k)
- Product: Dedicated GPU pool + Hosted API fallback for DR/peak (adds ops complexity)

Why I think we should make an exception:
- Strategic reference in genomics imaging; customer willing to be a case study and co-market.
- Opportunity to convert to larger Dedicated commitment in year 2 with predictable uplift.
- Legal has flagged only one minor IP carveout; otherwise standard SOW.

Attached are three pricing scenarios (best case / balanced / protected-margin) with modeled gross margin and NPV. My recommendation is the "balanced" path: 25% structural discount + waive onboarding fee + a 6-month performance review with price reset if usage exceeds thresholds. That preserves some margin while closing the ARR and reference potential.

Request: need VP + CFO signoff (Marissa) for a one-off packaging/margin relief to offer the balanced scenario. Financial impact and model attached.

Timeline: customer expects a signed commercial memo by EOD Friday (2027-10-08).

Attachments: Synthex_Pricing_Scenarios.xlsx (scenarios + P&L), Synthex_Term_Summary_draft.docx (stub referenced in doc)

Next steps I propose:
- Markus: quick read for margin tolerance and any lockup clauses.
- Marissa: signoff or counter threshold.
- Jonas: backstop conversation with customer on prepay and reference ask.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request for margin relief & custom packaging for Synthex Labs - background attached

Ben —

Thanks for the summary and the scenarios. A few quick clarifying questions before I can endorse: 

1) Can you confirm expected gross margin (post-cloud costs) for year 1 under the "balanced" scenario? Your workbook shows 38% but line items for cache/burst were lower than our typical ops assumptions.
2) The Hosted fallback adds licensing + outbound egress / cross-region costs. Do we have a cap on fallback utilization? If open-ended it kills the math.
3) What is the churn/expansion protection? Is there an MTU or commit floor if usage runs below expectations?

If we can tighten fallback caps (e.g., 5% of monthly token volume) and preserve a 30% effective gross margin, I can make the finance note. If the prepay is 30% and we align legal SOW terms for rollback clauses, this looks doable.

Please paste short answers inline so I can escalate to Marissa with numbers.

-Markus
Director, Revenue Finance

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T13:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Request for margin relief & custom packaging for Synthex Labs - background attached

Markus — answers inline below.

> 1) Can you confirm expected gross margin (post-cloud costs) for year 1 under the "balanced" scenario? Your workbook shows 38% but line items for cache/burst were lower than our typical ops assumptions.
- Confirmed: I updated the workbook to model a conservative ops uplift (+12% on cloud costs) — balanced scenario revised gross margin = 33% (year 1). See tab "Balanced_v2" in attached XLSX.

> 2) The Hosted fallback adds licensing + outbound egress / cross-region costs. Do we have a cap on fallback utilization? If open-ended it kills the math.
- Proposed contract language: Hosted fallback allowed up to 7% of total monthly token throughput during normal operations; any usage above 7% billed at standard public API rates. Legal is comfortable with a cap and an overage billing mechanism.

> 3) What is the churn/expansion protection? Is there an MTU or commit floor if usage runs below expectations?
- Include a 60% minimum consumption guarantee (MCG) measured as % of committed monthly units averaged over trailing 3 months. If usage < MCG for two consecutive quarters, customer pays shortfall equal to the delta at list rates. Also propose a 6-month performance review with possible price reset if usage materially exceeds planned capacity (protects us in upside).

I attached Balanced_v2 and a short commercial memo. The deal economics with 30% prepay and the MCG puts our worst-case year-1 margin at ~30%.

Ben

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T09:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Request for margin relief & custom packaging for Synthex Labs - background attached

Marissa —

Ben has a strong reference opportunity and the customer is firm on timeline. Finance numbers look improved after Ben's adjustments. From a GTM perspective I support the balanced scenario with the MCG and fallback cap. The only ask from Sales Ops is that we lock a 12-month exclusivity window for the specific co-marketing activities (no competing marketing with our direct competitors) — small ask from them in exchange for reference.

Can you provide CFO signoff or let us know what level of additional protection you'd need to approve? If we get sign-off today we can send a commercial memo and close next week.

Thanks,
Jonas
VP, Enterprise Sales

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T14:37:00Z
Subject: Re: Request for margin relief & custom packaging for Synthex Labs - background attached

Team —

Reviewed the updated model (Balanced_v2). I approve the one-off margin relief and packaging exception under the following conditions: 

1) 30% prepay collected at signature and applied to first invoice.
2) Minimum consumption guarantee (60%) included in SOW with shortfall payments at list.
3) Hosted fallback capped at 7% with overage billing at standard rates.
4) 6-month formal performance review; pricing may reset if usage exceeds thresholds in agreed manner.
5) Legal to confirm exclusivity language for co-marketing is limited to marketing channels explicitly listed (no product bundling exclusivity).

Conditional signoff granted. Markus — please prepare a short approval memo for the finance file and update the ARR recognition assumptions (we'll treat prepay as deferred revenue per GAAP). Priyom — loop Legal to finalize the SOW tweaks and ensure the exclusivity is narrow (marketing only).

Marissa
CFO, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Ng <alice.ng@synthexlabs.com>, contracts@synthexlabs.com
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-10-05T16:45:00Z
Subject: Signed commercial terms - Synthex Labs (balanced scenario)

Alice / Synthex team —

Great to confirm next steps. Internal signoffs are in place: Marissa (CFO) has provided conditional signoff for the balanced scenario. Attached is the updated commercial summary (Synthex_Commercial_Summary_v2.pdf) and the pricing scenarios workbook for your reference. 

Key points agreed: 
- 24-month commitment, 30% prepay at signature, balanced discount (25% off list), onboarding fee waived;
- Minimum consumption guarantee (60%); shortfall payments at list rates;
- Hosted fallback capped at 7% of monthly token throughput; overage billed at public API rates;
- 6-month performance review with potential price resets for material usage deviations;
- Co-marketing exclusivity limited to named marketing channels in the SOW.

Please confirm you want us to send the commercial memo for signature by EOD Friday (2027-10-08). Contracts, please reuse the SOW template and incorporate MCG + fallback cap language per the attached notes.

Thanks and excited to get this live.

Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Synthex_Commercial_Summary_v2.pdf (commercial memo), Synthex_Pricing_Scenarios.xlsx (final scenarios)
